description: RFC 0008 stage 2: the unified GameState serves 3..10 seats and must reproduce MultiwayState at 3..6 and the independent N-seat ledger at 7..10. Every mutation below is a semantic change to a rule that is decided by SEAT COUNT in the unified machine (the 3+ profile rather than the heads-up one); the multiway oracle must catch each. Recorded as 8 caught / 0 equivalent -- the equivalents are deliberately absent: every mutant here targets behavior the exhaustive walk exercises at three or more seats (the 3..6 lockstep against the real MultiwayState is what makes the catches non-vacuous).

equivalent: any_pending keeps a mid-hand folded seat pending and never closes the street
expected.rationale: The multiway oracle enumerates every legal action across the bounded three-active-seat fixtures for 3..10 seats and cross-checks the REAL MultiwayState in lockstep at 3..6. The mutants target the branches where the unified machine selects the multiway rule instead of the heads-up one (the post-refund all-in re-derivation, no big-blind option, mid-hand folding, the any-pending close, and the seated-blind/rooted-board validation), plus the seat-6 settlement widening. None can be equivalent: each changes a node the walk reaches and compares field-by-field, or a root the validation cases construct.

additional_targets.name: the shipped MultiwayState, which is the 3..6 reference

mutations.name: shipped multiway no longer derives all-in on a rooted board for a zero-stack seat
the contribution ledger still rejects seven players
refund_unmatched re-derives all_in in the multiway profile like the heads-up one
after_action treats a multiway fold as the end of the hand
after_action refunds the unmatched excess at a multiway fold
any_pending keeps a mid-hand folded seat pending and never closes the street
close_street clears raise rights in the multiway profile like the heads-up one
constructor closes a preflop root when fewer than two seats can act in a 3+ game
after_card closes a multiway street when fewer than two seats can act
validate rejects an ante in the multiway profile
